changes.title: Bomb creator persistence
changes.text: Keep the creator of a lit bomb through saves without inventing ownership for older bombs.

changes.title: Explosion and armor order
changes.text: Prepare attributed bomb damage once before armor while preserving neutral and environmental damage.

changes.title: Defused bomb ownership
changes.text: Clear stored bomb attribution when its fuse is frozen, lost or recovered.

changes.title: Blast stone creator
changes.text: Carry the thrower into a blast-stone explosion.

changes.title: Cursed explosion caster
changes.text: Use the real caster for cursed-wand explosions, including boss-owned damage.

changes.title: Original score label
changes.text: Explicitly label the unmodified earned score before any future custom adjustment.

changes.title: Bomb regression coverage
changes.text: Test actual explosions, saved fuses, armor order, neutral RNG and invalid ownership.

changes.title: Native scroll evidence
changes.text: Require meaningful touchscreen scrolling and separate before-and-after captures.

changes.title: Explosion verification report
changes.text: Record verified source boundaries and outstanding damage-slider coverage.

changes.title: Verified development handoff
changes.text: Record TEST138 evidence and the next source package without claiming physical testing.

changes.title: Required private build checks
changes.text: Require the complete core, Android and screenshot checks before verification.

changes.title: Exact build history
changes.text: Review every changed path against the immediately preceding compiled APK.
